map.输入果酸浓度与 pH 值，估算化学剥脱深度与作用层次: Enter the AHA concentration and pH to estimate the chemical exfoliation depth and the skin layer affected.
map.📖 查看「果酸焕肤深度估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "AHA Peel Depth Estimator User Guide"
map.游离酸比例 = 10^(pH − pKa) / (1 + 10^(pH − pK: Free-acid ratio = 10^(pH − pKa) / (1 + 10^(pH − pKa)); free-acid concentration = input concentration × free-acid ratio
map.pKa 常数：AHA（甘醇酸）3.83、BHA（水杨酸）2.97、TCA 0.6: pKa constants: AHA (glycolic) 3.83, BHA (salicylic) 2.97, TCA 0.66. The lower the pH, the higher the free-acid ratio and the stronger the exfoliation; pH guide: <2.0 highly irritating, <3.0 strong exfoliation, <3.5 moderate, ≥ 3.5 gentle. Depth grading: AHA is graded by the concentration–pH combination into very superficial (≤20% and pH≥ 3.5) / superficial / medium / deep; BHA into superficial / medium / deep by ≤10% / ≤20% / >20%; TCA into superficial / medium / deep by ≤15% / ≤35% / >35%. Used for the quantitative assessment of peel concentration and pH in acid-treatment planning.
map.💡 剥脱深度由酸种类、浓度、pH 共同决定。pH 越低、浓度越高，剥脱越深。游离: 💡 Peel depth is determined together by acid type, concentration and pH. The lower the pH and the higher the concentration, the deeper the exfoliation. Free-acid amount = concentration × 10^(pH-pKa) / (1 + 10^(pH-pKa)).
map.化学剥脱属医疗操作，须由专业医师执行，切勿自行操作: Chemical peeling is a medical procedure and must be performed by a qualified physician; do not do it yourself.
map.📚 深度解析：果酸焕肤深度估算: 📚 Deep Dive: AHA Peel Depth Estimator
map.成分党比对：同一浓度不同 pH 的渗透差异，理解为什么「同浓度不一定同效果」。: Ingredient comparison: the penetration difference between the same concentration at different pH, to understand why 'same concentration does not always mean same effect'.
map.术后护理：估算焕肤后屏障恢复所需天数，安排保湿修护节奏。: Post-procedure care: estimate the days needed for barrier recovery after peeling and plan the moisturizing and repair rhythm.
map.避坑提示：识别商家宣传的「高浓度温和」是否自相矛盾。: Pitfall alert: tell whether the marketing claim of 'high concentration yet gentle' is self-contradictory.
map.输入两者参数 → 水杨酸脂溶偏毛孔、甘醇酸水溶偏表皮，层级相近但靶点不同，按需求: Input both parameters → salicylic acid is lipid-soluble and targets pores, glycolic acid is water-soluble and targets the epidermis; the layers are similar but the targets differ, so choose by need rather than concentration alone.
map.水杨酸和果酸怎么选？: How to choose between salicylic and fruit acids?
map.油痘肌伴毛孔堵常用水杨酸（脂溶入毛囊），干皮提亮常用甘醇酸，按肤质定。: Oily acne-prone skin with clogged pores usually uses salicylic acid (lipid-soluble, enters follicles); dry skin wanting brightening usually uses glycolic acid; decide by skin type.
map.游离酸浓度由 pH 决定，pH 高则有效酸少、刺激低但效果弱，需平衡。: The free-acid concentration is determined by pH; a higher pH means less active acid, lower irritation but weaker effect, so a balance is needed.
map.本工具结果能定方案吗？: Can this tool determine the treatment plan?
map.不能。仅作原理示意，实际操作与术后处理请遵医嘱。: No. It only illustrates the principle; for actual operation and post-procedure care, please follow your physician's advice.
map.果酸焕肤深度估算工具，根据酸种类（AHA/BHA/TCA）、浓度与 pH 值，计: AHA peel depth estimator: based on acid type (AHA/BHA/TCA), concentration and pH, it calculates the free-acid amount and estimates the chemical exfoliation depth.
